decisions.reason: The necessary About-page copy change is already fully captured by its same-message MODIFY setting no_referral_rewards_copy.
The same-message MODIFY already captures that the no-referral commission is allocated by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners; the source does not change the commission amount or trigger.
The same-message MODIFY already captures both six tickets per referral-free purchase and weighted-draw allocation.
The source establishes no-referral reward behavior and FAQ wording but does not require a landing-page copy or layout change.
No book-cover placement, cropping, visibility, or sizing behavior is changed by the source.
Weighted allocation of no-referral tickets and commission does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, pool funding, or winner eligibility.
The source does not change the current or planned product name.
The source does not change the mint price, commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool share; it only specifies allocation behavior when no referral is used.
The source concerns referral-free purchases, not ticket issuance when a valid referral code is used.
Creating and allocating six tickets for a referral-free purchase does not alter ticket eligibility periods, post-draw reset behavior, or carry-forward rules.
The source changes no-referral ticket issuance and allocation, but does not establish a new NFT metadata field, visibility rule, or metadata contract scope.
The source does not change how book access, referral identity, badges, or active or expired tickets behave after NFT transfer.
